values: 敌人受到控制效果后会进入“溺水”，“溺水”的敌人受到的伤害提升；涅尔瓦释放大招后提升攻击力和攻击速度，普通攻击可以在“溺水”的敌人间弹射。

Enemies affected by control effects can be afflicted with Nerion's drowning effect and take increased damage. After Nerion casts his Ultimate, his ATK and ATK SPD increase, and his normal attacks can bounce between drowning enemies.

被动地，每名敌人累计受到6秒的控制状态时，对该名敌人施加“溺水”：造成350% + 35% ATK伤害，涅尔瓦对处于“溺水”的敌人造成的伤害增加30%，直到战斗结束。对伤害类型为魔法的敌人，施加“溺水”所需的控制时长缩短至4秒。
主动使用时，涅尔瓦使用潮汐之力增强自身12秒。潮汐之力持续时间内涅尔瓦提升22%攻击力和60 + 8点攻击速度，同时使自身的普通攻击额外携带“潮涌”效果：命中时会向“溺水”的敌人依次弹射“潮涌”造成额外220% + 30% ATK伤害，每个角色最多被弹射1次。

Passive. When an enemy has been under control effects for 6s, they take 350% + 35% ATK damage and are afflicted with drowning. Nerion deals 30% more damage to drowning enemies. And both effects last until the end of the battle.
This passive effect takes only 4s to trigger on enemies that deal magic damage.
Active. Nerion empowers himself with the force of the tide for 12s. While this effect lasts, his ATK and ATK SPD are increased by 22% and 60 + 8 respectively, and his normal attacks gain the Deluge effect: when a normal attack hits, it bounces between drowning enemies, dealing 220% + 30% ATK extra damage. Each unit can be hit by the bounce up to 1 time.
潮汐之力持续时间内的攻击力提升至24%，“潮涌”造成的额外伤害提升至240% + 30% ATK。
While empowered by the force of the tide, Nerion's ATK increases to 24%, and the extra damage dealt by Deluge increases to 240% + 30% ATK.
潮汐之力持续时间内的攻击力提升至26%，“潮涌”造成的额外伤害提升至260% + 30% ATK。
While empowered by the force of the tide, Nerion's ATK increases to 26%, and the extra damage dealt by Deluge increases to 260% + 30% ATK.
潮汐之力持续时间内的攻击力提升至28%，“潮涌”造成的额外伤害提升至280% + 30% ATK。
While empowered by the force of the tide, Nerion's ATK increases to 28%, and the extra damage dealt by Deluge increases to 280% + 30% ATK.
潮汐之力持续时间内的攻击力提升至30%，“潮涌”造成的额外伤害提升至300% + 30% ATK。
While empowered by the force of the tide, Nerion's ATK increases to 30%, and the extra damage dealt by Deluge increases to 300% + 30% ATK.
每隔若干次普攻得到强化：命中时击退敌人，造成额外伤害并眩晕。
After every few normal attacks, Nerion's next normal attack is enhanced. Upon hitting a target, the enhanced normal attack knocks the target back, deals extra damage, and stuns them.
每进行3次普通攻击后，涅尔瓦的下一次普通攻击会得到增强：在命中敌人后会击退敌人{KnockBack}格，造成270% + 30% ATK伤害并使其眩晕持续2秒。

After every 3 normal attacks, Nerion's next normal attack becomes enhanced. Upon hitting a target, the enhanced normal attack knocks the target back {KnockBack} tile, deals 270% + 30% ATK damage, and stuns them for 2s.
对范围内敌人造成伤害，短暂延迟后击飞范围内敌人并再次造成伤害。
Nerion deals damage to enemies within an area, then after a short delay, knocks enemies in the area into the air and deals damage again.
涅尔瓦向敌人最密集的地图格丢出长矛，命中时对周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成140% + 20% ATK伤害，并在2秒后升起激流，击飞相同范围内的所有敌人并造成210% + 30% ATK伤害。

Nerion throws his spear at the area with the most enemies. Upon hitting the target tile, the spear deals 140% + 20% ATK damage to all enemies within 1 tile. 2s later, a raging current erupts, knocking all enemies within the same area into the air and dealing 210% + 30% ATK damage.
长矛命中时造成的伤害提升至160% + 20% ATK，激流升起时对敌人造成的伤害提升至240% + 30% ATK。
Increases the spear's damage dealt upon hitting the target tile to 160% + 20% ATK; increases the damage dealt by the following current attack to 240% + 30% ATK.
长矛命中时造成的伤害提升至180% + 20% ATK，激流升起时对敌人造成的伤害提升至270% + 30% ATK。
Increases the spear's damage dealt upon hitting the target tile to 180% + 20% ATK; increases the damage dealt by the following current attack to 270% + 30% ATK.
长矛命中时造成的伤害提升至200% + 20% ATK，激流升起时对敌人造成的伤害提升至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases the spear's damage dealt upon hitting the target tile to 200% + 20% ATK; increases the damage dealt by the following current attack to 300% + 30% ATK.
战斗中，自身的攻击速度提升21点。
Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.
战斗中，自身的攻击速度提升27点。
Increases ATK SPD by 27 during battle.
战斗中，自身的攻击速度提升33点。
Increases ATK SPD by 33 during battle.
战斗开始时立刻为最靠后的敌人施加“溺水”。“溺水”的敌人攻击力与急速降低，处于控制状态时持续受到伤害。
When a battle starts, Nerion applies the drowning effect to the rearmost enemy. Drowning enemies have their ATK and Haste reduced and take continuous damage while under control effects.
战斗开始时，选择布阵格最靠后的敌人立刻施加“溺水”。处于“溺水”的敌人的攻击力降低20%，急速降低40点，并且使其每累计处于控制状态0.5秒就受到50% ATK的伤害。

When a battle starts, Nerion applies the drowning effect to the rearmost enemy. Drowning enemies have their ATK and Haste reduced by 20% and 40 respectively, and take 50% ATK damage every time they have been under control effects for 0.5s.
“溺水”的敌人处于控制状态时每0.5秒受到的伤害提升至60% ATK。
Drowning enemies take 60% ATK damage every 0.5s while they are under control effects.
施加“溺水”时，涅尔瓦立刻获得600% ATK的永久潮涌护盾，潮涌护盾在受到魔法伤害时的护盾损耗量降低60%。
Whenever Nerion applies the drowning effect, he immediately gains a permanent Tidal Shield equal to 600% ATK. The shield takes 60% less damage from magic attacks.
“溺水”的敌人处于控制状态时每0.5秒受到的伤害提升至70% ATK。
Drowning enemies take 70% ATK damage every 0.5s while they are under control effects.
所有非召唤物敌人处于“溺水”状态后潮汐之力永久持续，同时提升自身穿透。
When all non-summoned enemies are under the drowning effect, Nerion becomes permanently empowered by the force of the tide and increases his Penetration.
当场上的所有非召唤物敌人均处于“溺水”，或累计已有4名非召唤物敌人曾被施加“溺水”时，涅尔瓦立刻获得1000能量并使潮汐之力的持续时间改为永久。当涅尔瓦处于永久潮汐之力状态且能量大于800时，自身额外获得30点穿透。

When all non-summoned enemies on the battlefield are under the drowning effect, or if a total of 4 non-summoned enemies have been affected by it, Nerion immediately gains 1000 Energy and becomes permanently empowered by the force of the tide. While permanently empowered, Nerion gains 30 extra Penetration if he has more than 800 Energy.
